note: THE CANONICAL A04 RENDERING FIXTURE. Christian: "use the exact A04 concrete game from this closure run as the canonical rendering fixture. For this first test, do not reselect or re-realize it." So rendering reads THIS artifact and never a fresh run. Regenerated by `npm run freeze:a04` only when the chain itself is corrected — as on 1 October 2026, when the derived roster was found never to reach the concrete game — and never hand-edited. If a run would otherwise produce a different game, that is a separate finding and this file does not move. Since 7 October that finding is not left to be noticed: `fixture-currency.unit.ts` recomputes the game every run and fails on undeclared drift.

provenance.registerVersion: 6, adds the along-axis `longitudinal` selector attribute on S2 with its two end values and their interval tests, on the ruling of 2026-10-09 (Christian), so two opposing target regions can be told apart as AM-17 already lets two wide channels be told apart across the axis. Supersedes version 5, which added V8c and V8d. Nothing existing changes: AM-12 keeps derivation from rewriting any authored selector to use it.

along.asAuthored: attacking end (of the team J3 names for the objective referencing it; EACH_TEAM if shared): touches an end line, not the interior
along.why: the prose test is "touches the end line T attacks", which fixes one edge and states no depth The authored selector states end-near, which is tested as touching the 0 end line, so the anchor is that end rather than the other. The element's noun gives it extent in one dimension and its other axis carries that extent, so its extent on this axis is zero.

across.asAuthored: extends across the axis: the target lies across the direction of progression
across.why: An element spanning the whole of an axis, which is what "end line to end line" and "extends across the axis" both state. Axis-free, so one term serves both. APPROVED by Christian 1 October as a canonical addition to RC-21; no parallel spatial representation is kept beside it.

Both targets take the same noun so the two ends are symmetrical.

The initial holder of possession is a governed free choice, not knowledge: the Soccer Sport Profile bounds the relationship over the participating opposing teams and deliberately names no team, and SD-39 carries the choice. Either of the two established teams is a legitimate value, and the choice is arbitrary BY CONSTRUCTION rather than by neglect — the two members are indiscernible, which is precisely why which one starts cannot be derived and has to be chosen. Naming one handle commits to nothing about it: no football meaning is read into the ordinal, nothing downstream recovers instantiation order from it, and swapping the two would leave the game identical. Recorded against a qualitative bound, so it is reported as unverified rather than as checked (SD-15). CORRECTED 6 October: this was recorded as `#0`, and the realizer mints member handles from 1, so it named no team at all. It passed because the bound is qualitative -- boundCheck is UNVERIFIABLE_QUALITATIVE_BOUND, so nothing compared the value to the instantiated members -- and nothing reads `possession.team` yet. `realize()` now refuses a chosen value that has a handle shape and names no member, so this cannot recur silently.

instantiations.because: GF2-14.a asserts at least two teams exist and individuates none, so two members are instantiated to meet its cardinality. NO PROPERTY IS SUPPLIED: the previous `designation` values ATTACKING_TEAM / DEFENDING_TEAM were removed on Christian's ruling of 2 October as unsupported and unregistered content -- there is no register row for performers.teams[].designation, the stated reasons were positional ("first of the two"), and ATTACKING_TEAM is defined by canonical knowledge as the team CURRENTLY IN POSSESSION, which a static label cannot carry. No replacement is inferred.
